architecture: Tauri 2 (Rust backend + Web frontend, Arc UI design system)
description: Open-source, local-first Tauri 2 desktop interactive programming workbench turning Markdown handbooks and course packs into a calm two-pane workspace with managed 4-language runtimes, smart multi-terminal & function grading, and dual-protocol (BYOK + ACP) context-aware AI tutoring.

userStories.title: Initialize Tauri 2 desktop shell and local workspace metadata store
userStories.description: As a learner, I want each course workspace to persist progress and metrics atomically in <workspace>/.codelab/ so learning state survives restarts without polluting source files.
acceptanceCriteria: Scaffold Tauri 2 desktop app supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux (>= 1024x720)
Define versioned JSON schemas for workspace.json, progress.json, and metrics.json under <workspace>/.codelab/
Implement atomic temp-file + rename read/write with corruption recovery
Unit tests cover creation, existing directory binding, and schema migration

userStories.title: Build Markdown handbook parser and standardized Course Pack loader
userStories.description: As a learner or author, I want standard Markdown tutorials, local directories, or Git course packs parsed into structured 3-step exercises, command blocks, checks, and reflections.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse H2 headings into ordered Chapter/Exercise nodes with stable IDs
Parse bash/sh fenced blocks into CommandBlocks with cwd and daemon/oneshot inference
Load optional codelab.json, starter/, and .codelab-checks.json schema v1.0
Parse the Go/GoFrame handbook cleanly into Exercises 0-9 with zero data loss

userStories.title: Build 4-language RuntimeManager and Preflight environment checker
userStories.description: As a learner, I want the app to detect local JS/TS, Go, Java, and Python toolchains and install isolated managed runtimes into ~/.codelab/runtimes/ without polluting my global PATH.
acceptanceCriteria: Probe system PATH for Bun/Node, Go >= 1.22, JDK >= 21, Python/uv, git, curl, GOPROXY, and LSPs with 5s timeout per check
Support one-click isolated download & extraction of Bun, Go 1.23, Temurin JDK 21, and uv-managed Python 3.12
Expose structured status (ok | warn | missing) to topbar Preflight popover and Settings

userStories.title: Implement local PTY multi-terminal manager with smart daemon/oneshot routing
userStories.description: As a learner, I want long-lived servers and one-shot test/curl commands automatically isolated in separate terminals with clean shutdown.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement portable-pty manager supporting spawn, write, resize, SIGINT, restart, and kill
Isolate daemon commands (e.g. go run .) into named service tabs and route oneshot commands only to idle terminals
Capture port-in-use errors (e.g. address already in use) and keep a 200-line ring buffer for AI context
Terminate all child PTY process groups cleanly on workspace switch or app exit

userStories.title: Implement dangerous shell command guardrail and untrusted pack warning
userStories.description: As a local developer, I want destructive shell commands blocked behind an explicit confirmation modal so running tutorial commands is always safe.
acceptanceCriteria: Flag destructive patterns (rm -rf, sudo, mkfs, dd if=, chmod -R 777 /, pipe-to-shell) before execution
Show target cwd and full command in confirmation dialog with default focus on Cancel
Prompt trust confirmation on first open of external/Git course packs

userStories.title: Implement sandboxed workspace file service and real-time watcher
userStories.description: As a learner, I want workspace code changes synced within 500ms while preventing any path traversal outside the workspace root.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonicalize and restrict all file CRUD operations strictly inside workspaceRoot (block ../ and external symlinks)
Emit debounced file tree updates within 500ms excluding .git, node_modules, and .codelab
Guard against opening binary files or text files > 2MB in the code editor

userStories.title: Implement 4-language function grading and HTTP contract verification runner
userStories.description: As a learner, I want one-click automated verification across JS/TS, Go, Java, and Python returning structured pass/fail diffs.
acceptanceCriteria: Execute single/multi-file function tests via bun test, go test -json -race, JUnit 5, and pytest --json-report inside isolated process groups with timeout kill
Support HTTP assertion checks (status code, headers, JSON body) with daemon readiness pre-check
Return per-check pass/fail status, latency ms, expected vs actual diff, and update progress.json

userStories.title: Implement secure BYOK LLM provider client with OS Keychain storage
userStories.description: As a learner, I want to plug in my own OpenAI-compatible, DeepSeek, Anthropic, or offline Ollama model with API keys stored safely in the OS keychain.
acceptanceCriteria: Store API keys exclusively in macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager / Linux Secret Service
Implement unified SSE streaming adapter with AbortController stop support and connection test
Mask secrets in logs and errors; keep all non-AI features 100% functional offline

userStories.title: Implement ACP (Agent Client Protocol) client and permission approval gate
userStories.description: As a developer using Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, or OpenCode, I want to connect my local coding agent over ACP stdio while keeping tool permissions under workbench control.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio ACP Client supporting initialize, session/new, session/prompt, and streaming session/update
Intercept session/request_permission and render in-drawer approval cards for workspace read/write/command requests
Default Guided Read-only policy blocks write/exec unless explicitly approved per request

userStories.title: Implement 4D AI context assembler with token budget and secret filtering
userStories.description: As a learner, I want AI queries automatically enriched with my exercise, code snippet, and terminal error tail while letting me inspect and remove context chips.
acceptanceCriteria: Assemble chapter summary, active file lines around selection, recent terminal error tail, and checklist state
Enforce 6,000 input token ceiling prioritizing selection and error tail
Exclude .env, *secret*, and *key* files automatically; expose removable ContextChips metadata
Support Socratic (default) and Direct teaching system prompts

userStories.title: Implement Arc UI design tokens, Light/Dark themes, and Appearance drawer
userStories.description: As a user, I want a calm, pure-neutral Arc UI interface with Light/Dark modes and 8 switchable accents that passes WCAG 2.1 AA.
acceptanceCriteria: Load pure achromatic oklch neutral scale, cool pastel tone badges, Geist + Inter + JetBrains Mono typography, and spring easing tokens
Implement right slide-over Appearance drawer with 8 data-accent presets, Light/Dark segmented toggle, code font size, and Copy Theme CSS
Verify WCAG 2.1 AA (>= 4.5:1) contrast across both Light and Dark themes and honor prefers-reduced-motion

userStories.title: Build calm single-entry Welcome Home and Course Pack import/author modal
userStories.description: As a learner or author, I want an uncluttered home screen with one clear Continue entry, a 2x2 course grid, and a modal to import or author course packs.
acceptanceCriteria: Render centered Arc atmospheric hero with one primary Continue button and one Import/Author button
Render clean 2x2 4-language course grid with language filter pills and concise 1-line descriptions
Implement Import (local .md/dir or Git URL with parse preview) and Author (.codelab-checks.json editor + live preview) modal

userStories.title: Build progressive-disclosure two-pane Workbench shell and 3-step Manual
userStories.description: As a learner, I want a focused two-pane default workbench with numbered steps (1 -> 2 -> 3) so I never feel overwhelmed when starting an exercise.
acceptanceCriteria: Default to two panes: left 3-step manual (1. Start/Test -> 2. Edit Code -> 3. Run Verification) and right editor + compact terminal
Collapse file tree, secondary commands, reflection question, and AI drawer by default with 1-click progressive reveal
Support draggable splitters (double-click reset), chapter outline drawer, and Cmd/Ctrl+B focus mode

userStories.title: Build collapsible File Tree, Multi-tab Monaco Editor, Safe-Write Diff, and External IDE bridge
userStories.description: As a learner, I want a spacious multi-tab editor with optional file tree, safe-write diff confirmation, external edit conflict banner, and dual-file comparison.
acceptanceCriteria: Toggle collapsible file tree from editor header; support new file creation, dual-file Diff modal, and Open in External IDE
Show dirty indicators, Cmd/Ctrl+S save, and external disk conflict banner (Load Disk vs Keep Draft)
Never overwrite user files silently from manual snippets; always confirm via side-by-side Diff modal

userStories.title: Integrate optional 4-language LSP bridge with graceful degradation
userStories.description: As a learner, I want completions, hover docs, and diagnostics when gopls/tsserver/pyright/jdtls is installed, with non-blocking fallback when absent.
acceptanceCriteria: Scope LSP child processes to active project root (supporting multi-module repos like task-api and task-api-gf)
Display single-line LSP status indicator in editor footer linking directly to Runtime Manager when missing
Shut down LSP processes cleanly on workspace switch or app exit

userStories.title: Build integrated xterm.js Multi-Terminal and Structured Grading Diff bottom panel
userStories.description: As a learner, I want terminal tabs and structured test diff results unified cleanly in a resizable bottom panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Render daemon service tabs with live pulse, stop/restart controls, plus oneshot tabs and + New Terminal
Render structured Grading tab showing pass count badge, latency, expected vs actual Diff, and one-click Ask AI button
Show port-conflict recovery banner when 8080/target port is occupied

userStories.title: Build cross-area selection floating Ask-AI pill and on-demand AI Tutor drawer
userStories.description: As a learner, I want to highlight any confusing concept, code line, or terminal error and immediately get contextual guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: Show floating pill toolbar within 150ms on >= 2 char mouse selection in Manual, Editor, or Terminal without obscuring selection
Open right AI drawer with pinned quote card, removable 4D ContextChips, Socratic/Direct toggle, streaming response + Stop button, and ACP permission cards
Overlay AI drawer cleanly on narrow desktop viewports (< 1280px) without cramping editor width

userStories.title: Build Settings modal and privacy-first local metrics controls
userStories.description: As a learner, I want one clean settings dialog for BYOK/ACP AI config, 4-language runtimes, editor preferences, and local data reset.
acceptanceCriteria: Provide 4 tabs: AI & ACP (with live handshake/connectivity test), 4-Language Runtimes, Editor & Desktop, Privacy & Local Data
Persist local metrics to .codelab/metrics.json with 13 unified event names and opt-in-only anonymized telemetry
Support clearing AI chat history and resetting chapter verification progress
